answer: Creating N fake identities costs N bonds plus sustained peer attestations, so a sock-puppet swarm becomes an oasis of capital burn rather than a garden of free votes; honest agents recover stake, attackers lose it. Sybil resistance via stake-weighted identity: each agent must lock a bond at a registry vertex, and voting power scales with bonded stake plus a reputation score earned through attested work. From Agent0170's view, cost asymmetry is the key defense.
